name: vektorsec-desktop
description: VektorSec standalone desktop app (Electron) with HWID-bound DRM licensing — no Docker Desktop required.
author: PentestDB @ Developer By Raysiya

scripts.dist: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && npm run stage:deps && electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.package:win: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && npm run stage:deps && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never
scripts.package:win:nosign: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && npm run stage:deps && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never --config.win.signAndEditExecutable=false
